limitations: No generalization beyond length six is proved.
The coordinate-permutation group is used for the orbit statement; it is not asserted to be the full compatibility-graph automorphism group.
An obscure or unindexed prior equality-case enumeration remains possible.
Earlier relevant journal sources were not assigned an invented day-level public date.

scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Binary length six, one asymmetric Z-channel error only.
scientific_integrity.novelty_boundary: The known optimum 12 is not claimed as new; only the equality-case census and structure are claimed.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exhaustive finite classification with two compatibility definitions, two clique-enumeration routes, and an explicit constructive characterization.

title: Classification of optimal binary length-six Z-channel codes
